cohort: 858 women with twin pregnancies delivered by a single maternal-fetal medicine practice from 2005-2016, all with private health insurance and equal access to physician care
finding: Nonwhite women with twin pregnancies have an increased risk of cesarean delivery and gestational diabetes, even after adjusting for access to care.
mod_finding: Nonwhite women had a significantly higher rate of cesarean delivery (43.5% vs 16.1%) among those who attempted labor.
